name: @agent-bridge/codex-channel
description: First-class Codex channel for agent-bridge: automatically bind existing Codex tasks to stable title-derived codex/<alias> targets and push inbound BridgeMessages into the exact persisted thread via the Codex App Server (thread/resume + turn/start), with queue-while-active, crash-safe delivery state, and safe approval defaults.
